lines: Citizens, brothers, sisters, and siblings, soldiers of our Army and Navy!
My words are addressed to you, dear friends!
We understand your worries and fears about Spoilage and the threat it poses to our nation.
How could it be that our glorious guard of Verehn has been unable to cleanse our streets of this plague?
Is it really true that invincible monsters are roaming at night under our noses, as the braggart, traitorous propagandists are ceaselessly blaring forth?
Of course not! There are no beings above the science of our state.
No demons that could not be slaughtered with the tanks and rifles of our guard.
The internal enemies of the state are colluding with foreign adversaries who envy our rapid development.
They seek to scare our talented workers from exploring their full potential, telling false stories of monsters to make us fear our own home.
WE SHALL NOT DESPAIR! WE SHALL NOT GIVE IN TO THESE ENEMIES! VEREHN STANDS STRONG!
